title: 46 - Klown Kar Planet
summary: [[character:rudy]] reaches [[location:epsilon-indi]] ahead of [[character:edwin]] and, by Bob custom, counts his arrival from his first live [[technology:vr|VR]] session with [[character:riker]], who asks for a report once Rudy has seen [[location:klown-kar-planet|KKP]] up close. From [[character:linus]]'s notes and his own drone flights, Rudy finds the moon's life astonishingly varied, colourful and fiercely competitive, its light and heat partly supplied by the Jovian [[location:epsilon-indi-1]], which Linus has tentatively named Big Top; Linus's automated mining has also left a large stockpile of refined metal in orbit. Visiting Edwin, who is closing on Big Top with the colonists, Rudy proposes domes to keep out the [[species:ickies|ickies]], a flying, leech-like species, and Edwin looks forward to heading back to Earth once he unloads, while Rudy stays.

introducing.name: Rudy
introducing.description: A Bob who travels ahead of [[character:edwin]] to [[location:epsilon-indi]] to survey [[location:klown-kar-planet|KKP]] for the colony bound there, and who is to stay on in the system after Edwin leaves.
introducing.current_state: Arrived at [[location:epsilon-indi]], counting his arrival by Bob custom from his first live session with [[character:riker]], he surveys [[location:klown-kar-planet]] from [[character:linus]]'s notes and his own drones. He judges its ecosystem fiercely competitive and leans towards domes for the colony.

introducing.name: Edwin
introducing.description: A Bob who carries colonists to [[location:epsilon-indi]], with [[character:rudy]] scouting ahead. His VR is a living area whose huge windows show the real view outside his vessel.
introducing.current_state: Several million miles out and approaching orbital insertion around [[location:epsilon-indi-1|Big Top]], he jokes that the colonists may demand to be taken back once they see [[location:klown-kar-planet|KKP]]. Once he unloads them, he is to return to Earth.

introducing.name: Ickies
introducing.description: A flying, leech-like creature with multiple suckers on [[location:klown-kar-planet|KKP]], given its species name by [[character:linus]]. [[character:rudy]] finds the name apt and wants domes for the colony partly to keep them out.

updates.state: Its odd light cycles have bred life in a huge range of phyla, with several kinds of photosynthesis and a riot of colours, even in its oceans. Lit and warmed by its Jovian primary too, it barely separates day, night and season. With colonists arriving, [[character:rudy]] leans towards domes against [[species:ickies]].
[[character:linus]] has tentatively named it Big Top, though [[character:rudy]] doubts that name, or Klown Kar Planet, will survive the colony's first general meeting.

Though the system is not rich, mining drones and an autofactory that [[character:linus]] left in orbit with a beacon have refined asteroid ore into several hundred thousand tons of metal, a good start for the colony.
